body.prompt: Do these steps in order: 1) use Glob to list all files here. 2) Read package.json. 3) Run the shell command: wc -l README.md 4) Run the shell command: cat does-not-exist.txt 5) Use the Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose, description 'Read readme') to have a subagent read README.md and report its first line. Then summarize in one sentence.
